source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, perfectly flat surface filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Astrakhan (karakul lambskin): tight glossy curls of fleece packed close in small whorls and ridges, dark shadows between the curls. Fine scale: the whole frame is about 20 cm of cloth. Keep colours natural but slightly muted and even, so the texture can be tinted to different palettes without looking stained. Near-colourless: pale grey only, so it can be tinted.
